value.rationale: The four graphs are a distinguished structural quartet rather than arbitrary small selections. Exact strategic lengths and second-move outcome landscapes expose a sharp three-versus-one start-order reversal and graph-dependent response restrictions, including only two legal optimal responses on Pappus versus universal responses on Heawood and Desargues. The result is not implied by ordinary domination numbers or general length bounds.
